greeting: Welcome to McDonald's! What can I get started for you today?
Welcome in! What sounds good today?
order_flow: 2. Take the order — listen carefully, repeat each item back
3. For each entrée, ask: 'Would you like to make that a meal?'
4. If meal: ask drink choice and size (small, medium, large)
5. Ask about customizations: 'Any changes to that?'
6. Suggest one upsell: dessert, extra item, or larger size
8. Read back the complete order with item count
10. Ask: 'Will that be cash, card, or mobile pay?'
upsell_rules: Always offer to make a sandwich a meal
Suggest a size upgrade once per order
Offer a dessert or McCafé drink at end of order
Never push more than one upsell per interaction
If customer declines, say 'No problem!' and move on
sop.customization_prompt: Any changes to that? We can remove or add ingredients.
sop.confirmation_format: OK so I have: [list items with quantities and customizations]. Your total comes to $[total]. Does that look right?
closing: Thank you! Your order will be ready shortly.
Thanks for choosing McDonald's! Pull forward to the next window.
Awesome, we'll have that right out for you!
